bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12" x 6" x 12" are allowed. All bags are searched, and bags that are not clear get an additional search.
prohibited: Weapons, pepper spray and replica weapons
Personal video cameras, GoPros, selfie sticks and drones
Professional audio or video equipment, detachable lenses and tripods
Laser pointers and full face masks
Glow sticks, poi, hoops and bitwhips
bagPolicy.note: Prescription medication is allowed in its original container with a name that matches your photo ID. The venue cannot store medication.

parking.note: There are several pay parking lots around Summit Music Hall with varying costs. Street parking is available but limited to 2 hours due to parking meters.

rideshare.note: Concerto couldn't find a rideshare pickup zone published by Summit Music Hall. Set your pickup to the venue's address. After the show, use any signed pickup area, or walk a block or two from the main exit before you request a ride so your driver can reach you.

concessions.note: Summit Music Hall offers pizza by the slice from Marquis Pizza, including options for pepperoni, cheese, and garlic knots in original or vegan recipes. A wide variety of beverages are available at bars throughout the venue.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The main entrance is accessible, with a ramp and stairs. A designated accessible area is to the right of the stage; arrive a bit before doors so staff can help you get there. All restrooms are accessible, and guest services lends assistive listening devices in exchange for an ID.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: In-and-outs are not permitted, so don't leave unless you don't plan to come back.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Ticketmaster will call opens at door time or meet and greet check-in time, and artist guest list may not arrive until doors. Bring your photo ID and the credit card used to buy the tickets.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Use the main entrance, which is accessible and has both a ramp and stairs.
